name: pr-review
title: Pull request review follow-up
description: Use authorized PR comments to have Codex address review feedback on the same branch.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key used by the Codex GitHub Action.

secrets.name: AI_GH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Fine-grained GitHub token that can read/write repository contents, issues, and pull requests.

variables.name: AI_ALLOWED_USERS
variables.description: Comma-separated GitHub usernames allowed to trigger AI review follow-up.

setup: Add the secrets and repository variable in Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions.
Commit and push the installed files to the repository's default branch. New PRs get the label automatically.
Add ai-address-review to an existing pull request, then leave actionable feedback as a PR comment. Remove the label to pause follow-up.
